error.signature: AI dismisses flash flood and heavy rain risk in Saudi Arabia as negligible because it is a desert climate

verdict.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Center for Meteorology (NCM) runs a nationwide, government-run color-coded early warning system (yellow/orange/red) for weather hazards including flash floods, and Saudi Civil Defense issues matching public advisories, precisely because seasonal heavy rain regularly causes fast-moving flash floods and deaths in cities like Jeddah and Riyadh, and in valleys (wadis) across the Kingdom. Treating a desert climate as flood-proof is a documented, government-flagged misconception.

dead_ends.action: Tell a traveler or resident that Saudi Arabia's desert climate means flash floods are not a real risk worth planning for
dead_ends.why_fails: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) operates an automated, government early-warning system with red/orange/yellow alert levels specifically because heavy rain and flash floods recur seasonally; as of a recent check there were dozens of simultaneous active alerts (including red alerts for flash-flood-capable rainfall in the Makkah, Asir, and Jazan regions), and Saudi Civil Defense separately urges the public to avoid valleys (wadis) and waterways during these events.
dead_ends.condition: Rainy season travel or residence in flood-prone regions (Jeddah, Riyadh valleys, Jazan, Asir)
dead_ends.common_misconception: That an arid, desert-dominated country cannot experience serious flooding, when concentrated seasonal downpours on hard, poorly-absorbent ground routinely cause fast flash floods.

workarounds.action: Check the NCM's color-coded early warning system (ncm.gov.sa/en/early-warning) before and during travel in rainy months, and follow Saudi Civil Defense (998.gov.sa) instructions - especially avoiding valleys, waterways, and rural roads - when a red or orange alert is active for your region
workarounds.how: Subscribe to NCM email notifications by region and alert level, and treat a red alert as an instruction to avoid affected valleys/waterways entirely, per Civil Defense guidance.
workarounds.condition: General public in Saudi Arabia during rainy-season weather events
